from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BalanceSheetItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item extracted from a company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial item (e.g., '一年内到期的非流动负债')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency or unit (e.g., '元', 'CNY')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    balance_sheet_items: list[BalanceSheetItem]
